name: You See, I Want To Declare My Major!
source:
Play as an undeclared major and meet students from other majors to find the one for you! We're talking about majors.. obviously.

[from [url=https://6oymilk.itch.io/you-see-i-want-to-declare-my-major]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你還沒決定大學要主修什麼。去認識各系的同學，挑個最適合自己的吧！我們說的當然是挑科系……這還用問嗎？
